violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: Observed food employees using improper handwashing procedures. Observed employee rinsing off hands without using soap and water before attempting to return back to cooking
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. PIC stopped employee and had them wash hands following proper procedure.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: premade soups and sauces in the 2 dr uptight cooler lacked date marking stickers from time when it was made
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. PIC agreed to start date marking foods, follow up will occur in 10days to verify compliance

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: beef soup and various cooked RTE TCS food are being kept out not he counter without using time as a public health control markers to designate 4 hour endpoint
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. Follow up will occur in 10 days to verify compliance.

violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. violations.title: Dead or Trapped Pest Removed
violations.observation: Dead cockroaches were found on the premises under equipment rough out the kitchen
violations.corrective_action: Remove dead rodents, birds, and insects from the premises to ensure that the establishment is clean and sanitary and to prevent carcasses from attracting other pests. PIC agreed to clean and eliminate harborage conditions

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed throughout the facility, food being stored on the floor of the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. Person in charge agreed to find more storage so food will be maintained minimum 6 inches off the floor

out_items.name: Personal cleanliness

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints. Observed employees with long hair prepping and cooking food without wearing proper hair restraint.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. Person in charge made employees go put on hair restraints

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: rice scoops being stored ins tanning non heated water
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC agreed to remove rice scoops from standing non heated water

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of spices throughout the ktichen
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PIC agreed to stop using single use containers
